summary: Establishes the Presidential Commission on the United States Space Academy, chaired by the NASA Administrator, to advise the President on creating a NASA-led federal academy for the space workforce. The Commission must report within 120 days with recommendations on governance, curriculum, service obligations, admissions, and siting.

agencies_tasked.agency_name: Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA)
agencies_tasked.task: Serve as Chair of the Presidential Commission on the United States Space Academy.
agencies_tasked.source_quote: The Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) shall serve as Chair of the Commission.

agencies_tasked.agency_name: Presidential Commission on the United States Space Academy
agencies_tasked.task: Advise and assist the President on proposals to establish the Space Academy, and report with recommendations.
agencies_tasked.source_quote: The Commission shall advise and assist the President regarding proposals to establish the United States Space Academy

deadlines.due_description: within 120 days of the date of this order
deadlines.responsible_party: Presidential Commission on the United States Space Academy
deadlines.source_quote: Within 120 days of the date of this order, the Commission shall submit to the President through the APST and the APEP a report proposing key details for the establishment of the Space Academy.

authorities.source_quote: By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered
